### Public surface
- docs/spec/specification.md: Objective
- docs/spec/overview.md: Overview（根上的 peer sections：meta, system, frame, trajectory, forcefield, observables, method, status, metrics）
- docs/spec/frame.md: Containers（Column / Block / Frame / Box）
- docs/spec/trajectory.md: Trajectory
- docs/spec/collection.md: Collection
- docs/spec/system.md: System group
- docs/spec/forcefield.md: Force field
- docs/spec/observables.md: Observables group（kind-based，现行契约）
- docs/spec/run.md: Run surface
- docs/spec/status.md: Status group
- docs/spec/metrics.md: Metrics group
- docs/spec/method.md: Method group
- docs/spec/conventions.md: Standardized identifiers（atoms, atomi/atomj, system, status, metrics 等 molpy Frame/Block 域名）
- docs/spec/zarr.md: Why Zarr V3
- docs/spec/storage.md: Root layout（文档是 group attributes；frame-shaped group）
- docs/spec/chunking.md: Chunking and packing（`*.mrec/` 与 `*.mrec.zip`）
- docs/spec/metrics-wal.md: Metrics WAL（`*.mlp.jsonl` / `metrics/metrics.jsonl`）
- docs/spec/ragged.md: Ragged trajectory（CSR）
- docs/spec/lmdb.md: LMDB binding
- src/molrec/core/model.py: DocumentModel, ColumnModel, BlockModel, CellModel, BoxModel, FrameModel, MetaSeriesModel, SequenceColumnModel, SequenceBlockModel, SequenceSchemaModel, BlockState, BoxUpdateModel, TrajectoryBoxModel, TrajectoryModel, MetaModel, StatusModel, MethodModel, ArrayModel, ArrayNodeModel, NodeModel, ForceFieldModel（及 ForceFieldUnitsModel, ForceFieldSourceModel, SpecialBondsModel, StyleModel）, RecordModel, CollectionMetaModel, CollectionModel
- src/molrec/observables/model.py: ObservableMetaModel, ObservableModel, ObservablesModel, KNOWN_KINDS (`scalar`, `vector`), check_observable_name；数组复用 core.model.ArrayModel
- src/molrec/draft/observables/model.py: Array, Source, ObservableModel, ObservablesModel（dims 提案，不是契约；与 normative 同名类语义不同）
- src/molrec/ref.py: Ref
- src/molrec/core/bindings/zarr.py: Zarr frame / trajectory / record / forcefield codecs
- src/molrec/core/bindings/lmdb.py: LmdbCollectionBinding/Codec、LmdbTrajectoryBinding/Codec、encode_frame, decode_frame
- src/molrec/observables/bindings/zarr.py: ZarrObservablesCodec（module `observables`）
- src/molrec/draft/observables/bindings/zarr.py: draft Zarr codec（module `draft/observables`）
- src/molrec/draft/observables/bindings/jsonl.py: draft JSONL codec
- src/molrec/suite.py: Suite, ConformanceSuite
- src/molrec/core/suite.py: FrameSuite, TrajectorySuite, RecordSuite, CollectionSuite
- src/molrec/core/ffsuite.py: ForceFieldSuite
- src/molrec/observables/suite.py: ObservablesSuite
- src/molrec/draft/observables/suite.py: ObservableSuite（不点名不跑）
- src/molrec/adapter.py: Implementation, Adapter
- src/molrec/core/adapter.py: FrameAdapter, TrajectoryAdapter, RecordAdapter, CollectionAdapter, ForceFieldAdapter
- src/molrec/observables/adapter.py: ObservableAdapter
- src/molrec/draft/observables/adapter.py: draft ObservableAdapter
- src/molrec/schema_export.py: PUBLISHED, VOCABULARY, export；`python -m molrec.schema_export schema`
- schema/: core、observables、binding、ref、report、draft/observables 的生成 JSON Schema
- fixtures/: run-minimal、precision.mrec.zip、每个已发布 schema 的 valid/invalid 实例

### Style summary
- docs/spec/*.md: naming=章名即契约；construction=散文为规范，模型与 codec 跟随，无 schema version、无迁移；errors=未命名键原样保留
- src/molrec/core/model.py: naming=`*Model`，frozen pydantic，extra=allow 的文档保留未知键；errors=model_validator 抛 ValueError，本模块不读写存储
- src/molrec/observables/model.py: naming=kind ∈ {scalar, vector}，未知 kind 原样携带；construction=meta 文档 + ArrayModel
- src/molrec/draft/observables/model.py: naming=dims 与共享坐标；construction=独立模型树，schema 在 schema/draft/observables/；不进入现行契约
- src/molrec/core/bindings/zarr.py: naming=Zarr*Codec，活目录 `*.mrec`；construction=模型与 Zarr 组的仲裁 codec，文档进 group attrs，轨迹用 CSR
- src/molrec/core/bindings/lmdb.py: naming=单文件集合；construction=与 Zarr 同一套模型，不另立记录语义
- src/molrec/suite.py: construction=正例双向、负例单向；errors=只有 Refusal 算拒绝
- src/molrec/schema_export.py: construction=schema 从模型生成，不手改
- fixtures/: construction=金样跟随模型与 codec

### Layer roles
- docs/spec/*.md: 规范散文。身份、节、容器、约定、绑定都在这里定义。模型不得另立语义
- src/molrec/core/model.py: 与 spec 同一份契约的 Python 陈述。Record 一个根；Column/Block/Frame/Box；trajectory 是 section
- src/molrec/observables/model.py: 现行 observables 模型。RecordModel.observables 指向这里
- src/molrec/draft/observables/model.py: 草案。采纳它才是对 observables/ 的规范性修改
- src/molrec/core/bindings/zarr.py: Zarr V3 参考 codec，仲裁者
- src/molrec/core/bindings/lmdb.py: 集合的 LMDB 参考 codec
- src/molrec/observables/bindings/zarr.py: 现行 observables codec
- src/molrec/draft/observables/bindings/: 草案后端，不是参考绑定
- src/molrec/suite.py 与各 suite: 一致性套件。实现只写适配器
- src/molrec/adapter.py 与各 adapter: 实现作者的门
- src/molrec/schema_export.py 与 schema/: 模型的生成物
- fixtures/: 金样
